title: Ops Nexus: admin automation hub and staged runbook tasks
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a small, centralized 'Ops Nexus' service that stages admin utilities and runbooks as first-class tasks. The goal is to provide a safe, auditable execution surface for support engineers: typed task schemas, credentialed ephemeral workers, idempotency checks, simulated dry runs, canary execution, and integrated telemetry. This ticket covers the MVP orchestration, the typed param validation layer, and integration points with Console rollouts and the telemetry pipeline.
comments: 2026-01-12 - Kickoff: scoped MVP features. Decided to focus on three core capabilities for initial rollout: (1) task schema registry and validation, (2) credentialed ephemeral worker execution, (3) dry-run + canary runner. Linked Confluence spec and sketched API contract.

2026-01-18 - Design review with PM/Design: agreed a minimal task schema (name, params, idempotency_token, required_permissions, rollback_hint). Design asked for explicit 'impact_level' field so Console can color-code tasks. Action: add impact_level to schema and update PRD.

2026-01-22 - Engineering spike complete: implemented prototype task registry and JSON-schema validation. Found edge case where long-running tasks need continuation tokens; planned follow-up as separate ticket.

2026-01-27 - Security sync: SSO/KMS integration required for ephemeral worker credential signing. Security requested KMS envelope for transient credentials and an audit envelope with signature. Marked security_review_required and added integration tests with dev KMS stub.

2026-01-30 - Integration: wired telemetry. Events emitted for task.create/task.dryrun/task.execute/task.complete with fields: task_key, actor, duration_ms, success, error_code, canary_percent. Dashboard mockup linked in links. Telemetry latency looks within budget on synthetic traffic.

2026-02-02 - QA smoke: dry-run path validated using 'safe-sim' harness. Canary runner executed 5% traffic to a sandbox worker pool. Noted one flaky rule where idempotency check incorrectly flags legitimate replays; added unit tests and a fix branch (PR #1823).
